B:

K:

[ဥ+စလ+ဏေ+တိ]
လှုပ်ရှားစေ၏။
R:
uccāleti：ဥစ္စာလေတိ （ကာ） （ဥဒ်√စလ်+ဏေ）
လှုပ်စေ၏။ ချောက်ချားစေ၏။
DOP: uccāleti pr. 3 sg. [ caus. of *ud + calati; cf S. uccalati], makes move; disturbs ; Sp 865, 28 (akataṃ kamman ti ādīni vadantā ~enti); Vin-vn 1668 (taṃ kammaṃ ~etuṃ na vaṭtati); — absol. uccāletvā, Sp 757, 16 (pāsāṇaṃ vā rukkhaṃ vā daṇḍakehi ~etvā); Sv 711, 7 .
CPD: ( uccāleti ), pr. 3 sg. [ sa. uccālayati], 1. to remove ( something from its place ) ; 2. (vinaya term ) to re-open a settled case (= ukkoṭeti q. v. ); — 1. thambhaṃ vā pāsāṇaṃ vā rukkhaṃ vā daṇḍakehi ~etvā pavaṭ- ṭentā gacchanti, Sp 757, 16 ≠ Vin-vn 978; musalena pāsāṇe ~etvā pavaṭṭeti, Sv 711, 6 (= Ja l 199, 23 , reading ubbattetvā for ~etvā); tato tato calayanti ~entī ti calakā, Mp-ṭ B e lll 1961 190, 18 ; — 2. "akataṃ kararaan" ti ādīni vadantā ~enti, Sp 865, 28 ( ad Vin lV 126, 5 ukkoṭenti), ≠ Vin-vn 1618 (~etuṃ na vaṭṭati).

uccāletvā.p: [U+cala+ṇe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having moved. (A) Having risen. (B) Having taken out.

uccāliṅgapāṇaka.p: [Uccāliṅga+pāṇaka] (pu) CL=7 A caterpillar was named Uccāliṅga, A caterpillar has many hairs. See - Uccāliṅga.
a: ဥစ္စာလိင်္ဂပါဏက(ပု)
[ဥစ္စာလိင်္ဂ+ပါဏက]
ဥစ္စာလိင်္ဂမည်သောပိုး၊ အမွေးများစွာ ရှိသောပိုး။ ဥစ္စာလိင်္ဂ-လည်းကြည့်။

B:
uccāliṅgapāṇaka： uccāliṅgapāṇaka（pu）

[ဥစ္စာလိင်္ဂ+ပါဏက]
K:

[ဥစ္စာလိင်္ဂ+ပါဏက]
ဥစ္စာလိင်္ဂမည်သောပိုး၊ အမွေးများစွာ ရှိသောပိုး။ ဥစ္စာလိင်္ဂ-လည်းကြည့်။
DOP: uccāliṅga m. [ interpreted as uccā + liṅga? cf S. ucciṭiṅga, “a small venomous animal living in water” ], a kind of hairy caterpillar or centipede ; Abh 623 (~o lomasapāṇako); — °- pāṇaka , m. , id. ; Vin III 52, 31 (bahuppadaṃ nāma vicchikā satapadī ~ā); Ja II 146, 6´ ( in long cpd; Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr -uccāliṅgapāṇika-); Sp 523, 23 (~ā nāma lomasapāṇakā honti, tesaṃ lomehi phuṭṭhaṃ aṅgajātaṃ kaṇḍuṃ gahetvā thaddhaṃ hoti); Spk II 111, 22 (rukkhanissitā ti ~’-ādayo, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee uccāliṅgapāṇādayo); — ~-daṭṭha, n. , the bite of an uccāliṅga; Vin III 38, 2 (~-daṭṭhena; Sp 523, 27 : ~-daṭṭhenā ti vuttaṃ, atthato pana ~-lomavedhanenā ti vuttaṃ hoti).
NCP: masculine id. a | uccaali"ngapaa.naka kind of hairy caterpillar or centipede.

NCP: neuter | uccaali"ngapaa.nakada.t.tha the bite of an uccāliṅga See also: uccālingāpāṇaka

uccāliṅgapāṇakadaṭṭhūpatthambha.p: [Uccāliṅgapāṇakadaṭṭha+upatthambha] (pu) CL=7 When the genitals become strong due to biting by Uccāliṅga caterpillar.
